title: Figures 17-18: Tic Tac CFD contours, Mach number at 700 mph and pressure at 1500 mph
description: Two color computational fluid dynamics contour plots of a capsule-shaped "Tic Tac" body at 1/6 scale, each with a numeric color-scale legend. "Figure 17. Tic Tac Mach Number at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 700 mph with Mixed Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" shows a low-Mach wake trailing the body, and "Figure 18. Tic Tac Pressure at 1/6 Scale, Air Temperature 223K and 1500 mph with Supersonic Inlet and Supersonic Outlet" shows a bow-shaped pressure front (in Pa) ahead of the nose. Page 42 of the BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report.
